subject: Request: Quick demo + runbook — marketplace search use case
messages:
From: Anna Gomez <anna@cartwise.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick demo — marketplace search & recommendations

Hi Marcus,

I signed up on the self-serve plan this morning and had a quick look at the docs. We’re Cartwise (marketplace for second-hand outdoor gear) and I’m evaluating adding a lightweight search + recommendations API to improve conversions.

Very high-level details:
- Use case: product search + session-based recommendations in the storefront and email follow-ups
- Monthly traffic: ~150k product views, peak Q4 expected ~300k/month
- Timeline: pilot in August, production rollout in October if pilot looks good

Would love a 20–30 min walkthrough of the Redwood API and any tips on cost/latency tradeoffs for this traffic shape. My availability next week is fairly flexible mornings EST.

Thanks,
Anna Gomez
Head of Product, Cartwise
anna@cartwise.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anna Gomez <anna@cartwise.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 17:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — marketplace search & recommendations

Hi Anna — great to meet you (virtually) and welcome to Redwood. I can definitely walk through the API and suggest an initial pilot configuration that keeps token costs low while preserving latency. Before we book, two quick clarifying questions so I tailor the demo: 

1) Traffic shape: of those 150k monthly views, how many unique end users and how many search queries per user per day are you expecting? Approx peak QPS during a sale window would help.
2) Query complexity: are you planning to use open-ended natural-language search (free text) or structured filters + short queries? Also, will you want embeddings for similarity/ranking or just text generation for rewrites?
3) Data flow & security: is Cartwise interested in the hosted Redwood API or would you prefer Dedicated/Private from the start for data residency?

Propose three 20-min slots (EST):
- Mon Jul 7, 9:30–9:50am
- Tue Jul 8, 10:00–10:20am
- Wed Jul 9, 11:00–11:20am

If one of those works I’ll send a calendar invite with a short intake form attached (1 page) so we can prep sample prompts and traffic numbers. Otherwise drop 2–3 times that work.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood-inference.com
https://cal.redwood.ai/marcus/15m

From: Anna Gomez <anna@cartwise.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — marketplace search & recommendations

Thanks Marcus — quick answers below and I can take the earliest slot on Jul 7 if it’s still free.

1) Users/queries: ~40k monthly active users today, we expect 1.5–2 queries per active user per day. Peak QPS estimate: ~8–12 qps during flash sales (short bursts).
2) Query complexity: mostly short free-text queries (e.g., “2-person tent light rain”) + faceted filters. We’re planning a similarity embedding layer for 'also viewed' and recommendations, and a lightweight reranker.
3) Deployment preference: we’ll start with hosted API for speed but need contract language for data retention and SOC2 evidence; if the pilot is successful explore Dedicated.

Jul 7 at 9:30am EST works for me — please send invite.

Best,
Anna
